en: Two cheap Runtime diagnostics help tell whether HD2Runtime is involved when a large mod setup loses frames. They do not assume Runtime is the cause, and they do not prove it isn't.
zh: 两项开销很低的 Runtime 诊断可帮助判断大型模组组合掉帧时 HD2Runtime 是否牵涉其中。它们既不假定 Runtime 是原因，也不能证明它不是。
comment: Diagnostics reference intro (paraphrases the SDK's docs/diagnostics.md). new: needs native review

en: The bound SDK ({1}) has no Lua stub declaration for {0}. Runtime diagnostics are published from HD2Runtime 0.28.0.
zh: 当前绑定的 SDK（{1}）的 Lua 存根中没有 {0} 的声明。Runtime 诊断自 HD2Runtime 0.28.0 起发布。
comment: {0}: hd2.diagnostics (API name); {1}: SDK version. new: needs native review

en: Write conflicts (always on)
zh: 写入冲突（始终开启）
comment: Diagnostics reference section heading. new: needs native review

en: An {0} keeps its target at the value it wrote and re-checks only the bytes it owns. When those bytes changed while their allocation is still the reviewed one, something else wrote them: Runtime re-applies its value and counts the change for that operation.
zh: {0} 会让目标保持为它写入的值，并且只复查它拥有的字节。如果这些字节在其内存分配仍是已审核的那一份时发生了变化，说明有其他东西写入了它们：Runtime 会重新应用自己的值，并为该操作记一次变化。
comment: {0}: hd2.ensure (API name). new: needs native review

en: After 3 external changes within the operation's window (five of its verification intervals, at least 10 s), Runtime logs one line naming the operation, its target and up to four fields, the count and the time span. The next warning for that operation waits a full window.
zh: 在该操作的时间窗口内（其五个校验间隔，至少 10 秒）出现 3 次外部变化后，Runtime 会记录一行日志，写明操作、其目标和最多四个字段、次数以及时间跨度。该操作的下一次警告要等满一个完整窗口。
comment: Diagnostics reference: when the write-conflict warning is logged. new: needs native review

en: A game reallocation is not a write conflict: the game rebuilt its data, and Runtime re-resolves it the normal way. The counting runs only on a detected drift, never per frame.
zh: 游戏重新分配内存不算写入冲突：那是游戏重建了自己的数据，Runtime 会按常规方式重新解析。计数只在检测到偏移时进行，从不逐帧运行。
comment: Diagnostics reference: what is not counted, and the cost. new: needs native review

en: Two mods writing the same bytes fight: each re-applies its own value, Runtime at most once per verification interval. If a report shows conflicts, remove one of the two mods (or one of the two edits); if it shows none, a frame-rate loss is not Runtime fighting another writer.
zh: 两个模组写入同一批字节时会互相争夺：各自重新应用自己的值，Runtime 每个校验间隔最多一次。如果报告显示存在冲突，请移除两个模组之一（或两处修改之一）；如果没有冲突，掉帧就不是 Runtime 在与其他写入方争夺。
comment: Diagnostics reference: how to read a write-conflict report. new: needs native review

en: Telemetry (off by default)
zh: 遥测（默认关闭）
comment: Diagnostics reference section heading. new: needs native review

en: ModBuilder never turns telemetry on: no generated operation, snippet or insert button contains it. To produce a report, add the documented call to your custom Lua yourself:
zh: ModBuilder 从不开启遥测：任何生成的操作、代码片段或插入按钮都不包含它。如需生成报告，请自行在自定义 Lua 中加入文档所述的调用：
comment: Diagnostics reference: shown above the documented opt-in call. new: needs native review

en: Every report interval, Runtime then logs the average, p95, p99 and maximum of its whole per-frame update, of one ensure byte-check and of event polling, with the active ensures and re-applications. Disabled, it costs one boolean test per timed section; timing needs the game's precise clock (in game).
zh: 此后每个报告间隔，Runtime 会记录其每帧完整更新、一次 ensure 字节检查以及事件轮询的平均值、p95、p99 和最大值，并附上活动中的 ensure 数和重新应用次数。关闭时，每个计时区段只多一次布尔判断；计时需要游戏的精确时钟（在游戏中）。
comment: Diagnostics reference: what telemetry logs. new: needs native review

en: {0} without arguments returns the state and the running interval's sections.
zh: 不带参数调用 {0} 会返回当前状态和本次间隔的各区段。

en: To ask for a report, a user with a large setup adds a small mod that enables telemetry, plays one mission and sends {0}. The checks below the editor warn while a script turns telemetry on, so it does not end up in a published mod by accident.
zh: 如需报告，使用大型模组组合的用户可以添加一个开启遥测的小模组，玩一局任务，然后发送 {0}。当脚本开启遥测时，编辑器下方的检查会给出警告，以免它被意外带进发布的模组。

en: {0} writes a line to {1}, prefixed with the mod id. A failing callback (event, timer or keybind) is logged with the mod, the event and the error, never stops the other subscribers, and disables its subscription after {2} consecutive failures.
zh: {0} 会向 {1} 写入一行，并以模组 ID 为前缀。出错的回调（事件、计时器或按键绑定）会连同模组、事件和错误一起记录，绝不会阻止其他订阅者，并在连续失败 {2} 次后禁用该订阅。
